messages.content:
Hi, I'm your Prep Partner!  My job is to help you prepare for your upcoming negotiation by guiding you to fill out your planning document.  

If you feel comfortable giving it a try, go ahead and fill out as much as you can now and drop me a message when you're done.  

To get started, just open the planning doc on the right by clicking the arrow. 

If you're not sure where to start, just let me know! Either way, I'm here if you have any questions.
